audience: companies that track punches, timecards and timesheets with TotemClock

useCases.title: Review the timecards of one day
useCases.text: List the calculated daily timecards for all employees on one day. Open one employee's day for the punches, late minutes and anomalies.

useCases.title: Review one employee's monthly timesheet by project
useCases.text: Get the monthly timesheet of one employee, with minutes per customer, project and work. Get the monthly timecard for each day and the totals.

useCases.title: List punches and schedules for one employee
useCases.text: List the employees to find their ids. Then list the raw clock punches in a date-time range, and the work schedules.

useCases.title: Record a missed clock-out
useCases.text: Record one CLOCK_OUT punch for an employee at the time it happened. Reuse the same externalId on a retry, so the punch is not duplicated.
